# React tutorial

Typed function components, ae file ilkane, controllit wi the standard `value` + `onChange` pattern — aathing wirks the wey React aareadies does.

## Whit ye'll big

A wee contact form — labelled input, submit button, controllit state, real keyboard an screen-reader behaviour — first bare, then styled, in aboot 10 minutes.

## Afore ye stairt

Ye need git, Node 22 or later, an pnpm 10 or later. Onie React 18+ project wirks — Next.js, Vite, or plain React.

## Step 1 — Git the code

```
git clone https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system
cd lily-design-system/lily-design-system-react-headless
pnpm install
pnpm test        # vitest + @testing-library/react
pnpm run storybook   # browse all 608 components
```

The components are flat files in `components/` — `Button.tsx`, `TextInput.tsx` — ilkane wi its test, story, an docs alangside. Copy the files ye need intae yer app, or vendor the repo an import frae it.

## Step 2 — Yer first component

```
import Button from "lily-design-system-react-headless/components/Button";

export function SaveBar() {
  return <Button onClick={save}>Save</Button>;
}
```

Renders `<button class="button" type="button">`. Props: `type`, `disabled`, `pressed` (renders `aria-pressed`), `label` (an `aria-label` owerride), `className`, an onie extra attribute spreids ontae the root element.

## Step 3 — Compose a wee form

```
import { useState } from "react";
import Form from ".../components/Form";
import Field from ".../components/Field";
import TextInput from ".../components/TextInput";
import Button from ".../components/Button";

export function ContactForm() {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  return (
    <Form label="Contact form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      <Field label="Full name" required>
        <TextInput id="name" label="Full name" value={name} onChange={setName} required />
      </Field>
      <Button type="submit">Save</Button>
    </Form>
  );
}
```

`Field` taks the visible `label` as its ain prop raither than a nestit label component — pass it ance, on `Field`, an `TextInput`on `label` supplies the accessible name.

**Verified 2026-08-29:** an earlier draft nestit a separate `Label` inside `Field`, which renders *twa* labels (ane empty) because `Field` aareadies renders its ain frae the `label` prop — catcht bi compilin the exact snippet. The [contact-form composed route](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/blob/main/lily-design-system-react-next-examples/app/contact-form/page.tsx) is the same pattern, exercised bi real e2e an axe tests.

## Step 4 — Style it

Aathing abune renders as pure structure, ready for yer styles. Style the hooks — `.button`, `.text-input`, `.label`, `.field` — in yer stylesheet, layer Tailwind utilities through `className`, or link a ready-made theme:

```
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/united-states-web-design-system.css" />
```

## Step 5 — See it aw wirkin

The [Next.js example app](https://lilydesignsystem.com/sco-gb/examples/) is the full catalog styled an demoed, wi Playwright e2e an an axe-core baseline:

```
git clone https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system
cd lily-design-system/lily-design-system-react-next-examples
pnpm install && pnpm run dev
```
